claims.text: Experiments are conducted on the IWSLT14 German-to-English and WMT14 English-to-German tasks, using different model configurations and learning rates.
The experiments investigate the necessity of the learning rate warm-up stage and its sensitivity to the value of T_warmup.
The experiments are repeated multiple times with different random seeds to ensure reliability of results.
